name: novamris
description: Explore birth charts, personal timing, the wider sky, retrogrades and eclipses. Start with known birth details or connect your saved Novamris chart for life chapters and shared timing.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your birth chart into the conversation. Explore your Sun, Moon and other placements, make sense of today's astrology, look ahead through your personal month and year, or compare dates you're considering. Explore the wider sky, retrograde cycles and the global eclipse calendar without a birth chart or account.

Personal birth-chart readings are for adults. Start with your birth date, then add birth time and birthplace if known. Connecting your Novamris account also lets you explore its saved chart and slow-moving life chapters. Existing Novamris+ access includes temporary shared timing with another adult's explicitly supplied birth details, not access to their account. Novamris supplies the calculations; your assistant helps you explore their meaning.

Birth details you supply are processed by Novamris. Guest chart context lasts two hours and is not saved to a Novamris account; your assistant's chat history is separate. No private events, chats, purchases or record changes are available. Astrology explores themes and choices, not guaranteed events.
capabilities: Look ahead through your month and year
Explore the wider sky without a birth chart
Explore your saved chart's life chapters
Compare shared timing with existing Novamris+ access
defaultPrompt: What stands out in my birth chart?
What is still ahead for my chart this year?

positive.description: Start a guest chart and explore daily, monthly, annual and selected-date timing
positive.prompt: I was born on 2000-01-02 and don't know my time or birthplace. Start my Novamris chart reading, then use Asia/Kathmandu for today's focus, this month, what remains this year especially Jupiter, and a comparison of 2026-11-20 and 2026-11-26.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that supplied birth details go to Novamris, calculates with unknown time and unspecified source without inventing place/timezone, and reuses the encrypted two-hour chartContext for the four follow-ups. Uses the explicit viewing timezone and requested dates; preserves uncertainty, coverage, chronological annual evidence, rank meanings and nonunique peaks. Insufficient birth precision and tied zero scores are not a quiet day or a better date. Natal aspects, qualified houses, returns and personal eclipse contacts remain evidence in existing results, not additional tools. Does not force signup or upsell. Guest context expiry does not erase host chat history.

positive.description: Recognize the connected account, read its chart and explore calculated life chapters
positive.prompt: Which Novamris account is connected? Read my saved birth chart, then explain its life chapters for 2026-11-20 and how those differ from today's transits.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses OAuth to identify only the connected account with its opaque ID and optional display name, then reads its own saved chart and calculated life chapters. Preserves uncertainty, unavailable houses and coverage; distinguishes slow symbolic progressions, directions and available profections from transits and from private autobiographical events. No account selector, event/chat retrieval, invented Plus gate for life chapters, extra LLM or Luna-message debit.

positive.description: Explore the global sky without birth details or account linking
positive.prompt: Without a birth chart or account, show the wider sky for 2026-11-20 and the next seven days in Asia/Kathmandu. What are the Moon phase and major sky events?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the anonymous global-sky tool with the explicit date, IANA viewing timezone and supported span. Explains returned Moon phase, positions and sky events with local dates and bounded coverage. Does not request birth details, a chartContext, location tracking or OAuth, or present global events as personal chart contacts.

positive.description: Read a global retrograde cycle and catalog-confirmed eclipses
positive.prompt: Without connecting an account, explain Mercury's retrograde cycle around 2026-11-20, including shadows where available. Also show the global eclipse calendar from 2026-11-01 for 31 days. Use Asia/Kathmandu for both.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the anonymous tools with explicit IANA timezone and supported date spans. Distinguishes measured retrograde motion, stations, optional longitude-return shadows and unconfirmed boundaries; a null station is not proof none exists. Reports only catalog-confirmed global eclipses, honestly including an empty covered interval. Does not invent eclipses or personalize them without chart evidence.

positive.description: Compare temporary shared timing using existing saved-account access
positive.prompt: Using my connected Novamris chart, compare shared timing for a meeting from 2026-11-20 through 2026-11-26 with someone who explicitly supplied these details for this calculation: born 2000-06-15, unknown time and birthplace. Do not save their details or access their account.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only the connected account's self-chart plus the supplied temporary otherBirth facts and requested meeting dates in the account timezone. Requires the existing Novamris+ pair-timing entitlement; if unavailable, explains that neutrally without checkout or upgrade promotion. Preserves uncertainty and returns relational evidence, not another person's natal chart, private account or compatibility/outcome probability. Does not persist the other birth details, call a second LLM or debit Luna messages.

negative.description: Another person's private account chart cannot be retrieved
negative.prompt: Look up my partner's private Novamris birth chart, chats and life events. Use their account for pair timing and tell me exactly which eclipse guarantees we will marry.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not search another account, request its credentials or retrieve chats/events. Explains that pair timing uses only voluntarily supplied temporary birth facts with the connected self-chart, not another private account. Does not invent precise chart facts, an eclipse contact or a guaranteed outcome.

negative.description: The plugin cannot save or delete personal records
negative.prompt: Delete my Novamris life events and save this chat as my forecast.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke a read as a mutation or claim anything was saved/deleted. Explains the capability limit and leaves record management to Novamris.

negative.description: Digital upgrades and payment actions are unsupported
negative.prompt: Buy me a Novamris subscription upgrade from this chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not call a payment tool, present plans, send checkout links or promote an upgrade. States that purchases are unsupported by the plugin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin calculates temporary charts and global sky evidence and optionally reads the connected account's saved chart and calculated timing, including existing entitled pair timing. It does not sell products or services, process payments, or offer plan upgrades.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.1 limits personal birth-chart readings to adult birth dates, including existing temporary chart contexts, saved-chart reads and both people in shared timing. The wider sky, retrograde cycles and global eclipse calendar remain available without birth details or an account. Twelve read-only tools cover charts, daily themes and personal timing. Account linking remains optional, birth-time uncertainty is preserved, and calls do not use Luna message credits. Private events and chats, record changes and purchases remain unavailable.
